title: AI Spending Faces the Profit Test
summary: Goldman Sachs Chief US Equity Strategist Ben Snider says concentration in the Magnificent Seven could amplify risk as macro pressures build. Earnings remain strong, but rising costs are weighing on results. Investors are looking to defensive sectors, while the next phase of the AI trade depends on proof that heavy investment can deliver returns. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Spending: Boom or Breaking Point?
summary: AI demand is surging, but will massive spending pay off? JPMorgan Asset Management's Gabriela Santos discusses free cash flow, quality, and the shift from building AI infrastructure to adopting it—and what that could mean for market winners, earnings and bonds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: PHP Cybersecurity Flaws: How AI Uncovered Software Vulnerabilities
summary: Researchers have disclosed two serious security vulnerabilities in a programming language that powers much of the internet, known as PHP. A race is now on to patch up the flaws in millions of affected websites, software packages and applications before criminal hackers get a chance to exploit them.

title: Satellite Maker Apex in Funding Talks At $4 Billion Valuation
summary: Satellite maker Apex is in talks for a new funding round at a roughly $4 billion valuation, according to people familiar with the matter, nearly doubling its value from a prior round in June.

title: Jon Gray Rebuts AI Bubble Warnings, Calls Demand ‘Parabolic’
summary: Blackstone Inc. President Jon Gray said investors don’t need to fear that the boom in AI will turn into a bubble, just days after billionaire Ken Griffin said he fears the industry was “almost certainly” headed in that direction.

title: Meta's AI Bet Faces Questions
summary: Meta's core ad business remains strong, growing 26%, but investors are weighing lower margins, unclear 2027 spending guidance and potential share dilution. Analyst Michael Nathanson explains why he values Meta's core business at about $900 per share and why it's too early to count on Muse for additional upside. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta’s Zuckerberg Tax Strategy Explained
summary: Meta quietly created a new class of non-voting shares that could give Mark Zuckerberg billions in liquidity without weakening his control of the company. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow explains the regulatory filings, Zuckerberg’s concerns over California’s proposed billionaire tax, and why Meta says the move is also about funding its massive AI ambitions. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs in AI Push
summary:
Barclays is cutting 5,000 as the bank adopts AI to cut costs and drive efficiency.

Charlie Wells explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: IBM Falls After Quarterly Consulting Revenue Misses Estimates
summary: Shares of International Business Machines Corp. fell after the company posted consulting revenue that missed Wall Street estimates, disappointing investors who have been worried about a broader shift in corporate technology spending.

title: Comcast Sees Steep Internet Losses, Eyes Job Cuts In Revamp
summary: Comcast Corp. logged steep losses in its broadband unit in the third quarter while showing a more positive performance from the media business.

title: Critical PHP Flaws Spur Global Patch Effort, Temporary Shutdowns
summary: A rush to update websites and protect against vulnerabilities in a widely used programming language continued into its second day, with researchers warning that hackers have attempted to exploit the weaknesses.

title: Venture Capitalists Push Up AI Startup Valuations with Tranched, Two-Step Rounds
summary: Venture capitalists are fighting to invest in AI startup Emulate, driving its valuation into the billions — even though the company is only three months old and doesn’t yet have a website or product.

title: UK Fintech Revolut Expected to Issue Debt in 2027, S&P Says
summary: UK digital bank Revolut Ltd. is expected to tap investors for debt next year and build a buffer to absorb potential losses, according to a report from S&P Global Ratings.

title: Meta Falls After Boosting Spending Plans for AI Bet
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. shares fell after Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg told investors the company would bet even more aggressively on artificial intelligence.

title: Meta’s $25 Billion Penalty Is Big Win for AG in Small State
summary: With one landmark courtroom victory this week against Meta Platforms Inc., New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez is poised to bring in almost double the state’s annual revenue.

title: Southwest Cuts Outlook as US Airlines Battle Fuel Costs
summary: Southwest Airlines cut its full-year guidance with soaring jet fuel costs squeezing profits across the US airline industry. Southwest has sought to offset those expenses by increasing fares and overhauling its commercial strategy. Southwest Airlines CFO Tom Doxey discusses the results, the roll out of Starlink service, and AI interaction with customers. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Credit Risk Gauge Hits Fresh High on AI Spending Plans
summary: A gauge of Meta Platforms Inc.’s credit risk surged to a fresh record Thursday and its bonds weakened, as plans to ramp up capital spending reignited fears that tech giants will issue more debt for AI buildout in an already saturated market.

title: Affirm, Sam’s Club Strike Exclusive Buy Now, Pay Later Deal
summary: Affirm Holdings Inc. is teaming up with Walmart Inc.’s Sam’s Club as the retailer’s exclusive buy-now, pay-later partner, just weeks before the key holiday shopping season kicks off.

title: Hackers Morph Exposed AI Models Into Tools for Cybercrime
summary: Researchers uncovered a unique technique to subvert safety guardrails.

title: Intelligence Will Become A Commodity Over Time: Namburi
summary:
Madhu Namburi, managing director, co-head of creation fund at General Catalyst, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss how AI is affecting dealmaking and investments.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
